Name: SVSF (do not use)
Author: nastapolka
Description:
[size=5][b][u]How to use[/u][/b][/size]
[size=4] ﻿1. Do not download.
﻿2. Do not use.
﻿3. Do not even perceive this mod.

[size=5][b][u]How to actually use[/u][/b][/size]
﻿1. Install this mod
﻿2. Load the save file that got borked by older versions (<2.1) of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40055]other mod[/url] :x
﻿3. Play around for a bit if you want.
﻿4. End the day. (This saves the game).
﻿5. Delete this mod because it no longer does anything.
﻿ ﻿It could also get changed in the future to fix some other stuff, so you probably don't want it hanging around...[/size]

[size=5][b][u]What this does[/u][/b][/size]
[size=4] Upon loading a save, it does the following two things:
﻿1. If the player does not have the canReadJunimoText flag, it resets the progress for every bundle.
2. If the player experience in a skill is too low in comparison to that skill's level, it brings the experience
up to match.
e.g. They have fishing level 8 but only 815 fishing experience -> the mod sets fishing experience to 6,900.[/size]

Manifest.Name: Save Fix
Manifest.Description: Resets community center bundles if farmer doesn't have canReadJunimoText flag
Manifest.Author: nastapolka
